pacAllocator.name: PAC allocator
pacAllocator.description: Plan the purchases that bring a new investment as close as possible to its target allocation, in whole units or amounts, without placing orders.

portfolioRebalancer.name: Portfolio rebalancer
portfolioRebalancer.description: Bring an already invested portfolio towards its targets: it buys and, if you allow it, sells, estimating fees and taxes. It places no orders.
